dedupe_keys.name: evacuation drill data and pathfinder simulation outputs for an existing university building

description: This dataset holds aggregated data from an evacuation drill in an existing university building and the outputs of Pathfinder simulations of the same building. It was published on Zenodo on 27 July 2026 (version 1.0.0) by Alessandro Simas Franchetto and Angela Gaio Graeff of the Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The drill involved 299 participants; the data give cumulative evacuation counts at 60-second intervals and the initial distribution of people by floor. The simulations cover four scenarios: reduced occupancy with the existing staircase, full occupancy with the existing staircase, and full occupancy with one or two added stair cores, with door and room output tables exported from Pathfinder. Coverage is one university building and one drill. Access: a ZIP of about 2 MB and a README on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: no individual-level participant data or video; the building is not named in the metadata. Simulation uses: validation of evacuation models against drill data and testing of vertical egress design options. Related records: the Kutupalong settlement evacuation case study and JuPedSim.
